description: Figure 7 is a single bar chart illustrating the number of questions (out of 40) for which a GPT3-generated chain-of-thought (CoT) contains at least one factual error, shown for different methods. There are three single, solid-colored bars (one per method) with no stacking or grouping: the IRCoT bar (left) is the shortest at approximately 10 questions, the OneR bar (middle) is taller at approximately 20 questions, and the NoR bar (right) is the tallest at approximately 30 questions. The bars do not appear to be sorted by value beyond the displayed left-to-right method order, and there are no visible annotations, outlines, or other visual emphasis beyond the distinct bar colors.
